description: Core-shell slice: a decorated (OS-native title bar) window pointed at a broker's own /manage login, or -- in launcher mode, today's committed config -- the root-domain app/manage-launch picker first. window.vyxDesktop exposes isDesktop/rememberBroker/forgetBroker; the latter two are custom app commands and, since this window loads remote content, DO need their own allow-* permission below (see build.rs) -- confirmed the hard way: they silently failed with "not allowed. Plugin not found" until these were added.
